examples.text: Fredo hat mir Geburtstagsgrüße geemailt.

glosses: A system for sending messages and datas by means of computers connected together in a network.

examples.text: He sent me his details via email.
The advent of email has simultaneously brought our society closer together and farther apart.

Please stop sending me “constructive criticisms” via email, or telling me that “ I feel you are being defensive”, especially just after I have told you “you’re loved”. “Rewards” like that are horrible.

glosses: The quantity of messages sent through an email system.

examples.text: I am searching through my old email.
My inbox used to allow only 50 MB of email at a time until last year, when they upgraded it to 2 GBs!

glosses: A message being sent through email.

examples.text: He sent me an email last week to remind me about the meeting.
I archive my old emails using a cloud-based service.
What’s your email?
In this system, your username is your email.
Don’t send personal messages to my work email.

glosses: To send an email or emails to.

examples.text: She emailed me last week, asking about the status of the project.
I’ll email you the link.
He emailed the file out to everyone.

glosses: To send, or compose and then send, one or more emails.

examples.text: Most teenagers seem to spend almost the whole day emailing and surfing the Web.
